# Kevin Rebuilds

> Kevin Rebuilds is the independent business of Kevin, who designs and builds custom websites, web apps and automations for entrepreneurs and businesses. Clients work directly with Kevin, from the first conversation to delivery. The website is in Dutch (default) and English.

Kevin Rebuilds is based in Emmen, Drenthe (the Netherlands) and works for businesses in the region, across the Netherlands and abroad. It is a new, independent business. The examples on the website are clearly labelled demo concepts with fictional data, not client projects.

## Services (Dutch)

- [Website laten maken op maat](https://www.kevinrebuilds.com/websites/): professionele bedrijfswebsites, landingspagina's, meertalige websites, formulieren en een technische SEO-basis.
- [Webapp of klantportaal laten ontwikkelen](https://www.kevinrebuilds.com/webapps/): klantportalen, dashboards, interne tools, aanvraag- en offertemodules en MVP's.
- [Bedrijfsprocessen automatiseren](https://www.kevinrebuilds.com/automatisering/): systemen koppelen, aanvragen automatisch verwerken, bevestigingen, taken, meldingen en rapportages.

## Services (English)

- [Custom business websites](https://www.kevinrebuilds.com/en/websites/)
- [Custom web apps and client portals](https://www.kevinrebuilds.com/en/web-apps/)
- [Business process automation](https://www.kevinrebuilds.com/en/automation/)

## How to start a project

- Request a project via the form on the [homepage (NL)](https://www.kevinrebuilds.com/#aanvragen) or [homepage (EN)](https://www.kevinrebuilds.com/en/#request).
- Process: introduction → proposal with scope, timeline and price → design and build → test and deliver.
- Contact: webwinkelzakelijk@gmail.com
